driver.guide:
📖 How the driver bot works — in short:

1️⃣ Register: your name, phone, then vehicle type and plate.
2️⃣ Upload your licence and registration photos, then wait for admin verification ✅
3️⃣ Switch yourself to “available” 🟢 to receive orders — offline means nothing reaches you.
4️⃣ Each order arrives with distance and fare: accept ✅ or leave it; the fastest wins.
5️⃣ After accepting: head to the rider, then “arrived”, “trip started”, then “finished” 🏁

📌 What is expected of you:
• Update the trip status on time — the rider sees exactly what you pick.
• Do not cancel after accepting without a reason; repeated cancellations are reviewed.
• Protect your rating ⭐ — it raises your priority in dispatch.
• Your subscription must be active for orders to reach you directly 💳

🆘 Any time: the support button reaches our team, and the safety button is for emergencies.

rider.payment_notice:
💵 How you pay — read this before your order starts:
• You pay the driver directly at the end of the trip, in cash and outside the app.
• WASLA does not take your money, hold it, or guarantee it; no card, no wallet, no electronic payment.
• And WASLA does not set the amount or calculate it: the amount is between you and the driver, so ask before you ride.
rider.guide:
📖 How the WASLA bot works — in short:

1️⃣ Tap “Order” 🚕 and pick the service: a ride or a delivery.
2️⃣ Send your pickup location 📍 using Telegram’s location button, then the destination.
3️⃣ No amount is shown and there is no confirmation step: sending the destination starts your order ✅
4️⃣ We look for the nearest available driver 🔎 and tell you their name and car once they accept.
5️⃣ Follow the trip, and rate the driver ⭐ afterwards — your rating improves your next ride.

📌 What is expected of you:
• Send an accurate location — a wrong pin means a driver on another street.
• Be ready when the driver arrives; long waits cancel the trip.
• Payment is directly between you and the driver 💵 — we never ask for a card.
• Do not cancel after a driver has accepted without a reason.

🆘 Any time: the support button reaches our team, and the safety button is for emergencies.

miniapp.entry.welcome_rider: Welcome to WASLA. Requesting a ride, following it, your history and support all live in the WASLA app inside Telegram, and notifications arrive here. This chat keeps the emergency call and language settings.
miniapp.entry.welcome_driver: Welcome to WASLA. Offers, your current trip, subscription, documents and support all live in the WASLA app inside Telegram, and notifications and urgent offers arrive here. This chat keeps the emergency call and language settings.
miniapp.entry.help_rider: Everything happens in the WASLA app: request and follow rides, review your history and tickets there. In this chat: /sos for emergencies, /language for language, /delivery for a delivery request and /city to change city.
miniapp.entry.help_driver: Everything happens in the WASLA app: offers, your current trip, subscription, documents and support. In this chat: /sos for emergencies, /language for language, /area for your preferred area and /city to change city.
miniapp.entry.open_prompt: Tap the button to open the WASLA app.
miniapp.entry.moved: This is now in the WASLA app. Tap the button to open it directly.
reputation.heading: 📊 My ratings & reputation
reputation.empty: No ratings yet — your reputation builds from your ride ratings.
support.flag_usage: Usage: /flag <rating id> — an abusive rating is excluded from the average, never deleted.
support.flag_done: Rating {rating} flagged as abusive and excluded from the average.
support.flag_not_flaggable: Rating cannot be flagged: not found or already flagged.
documents.expiry_warning: Your {document} expires in {days} days (on {expires}). Please renew it soon.
negotiation.rider_presented:
🚗 Driver #{position} accepted your request.
View their details or choose them directly, or move to the next driver.
negotiation.rider_presented_deadline: ⏱ You have {seconds} seconds to choose, then we show you the next driver.
negotiation.rider_selected_closed: ✅ You chose driver #{position}. The chat with them is open now.
negotiation.card_stale: ⚠️ This card is no longer active — follow the latest message you received.
negotiation.rider_chat_opened: 💬 Agreeing with driver #{position}. Type here and your message reaches them directly. You have {seconds} seconds to agree.
negotiation.driver_selected: ✅ The rider chose you! Talk to them right here — send your message and it will reach them. You have {seconds} seconds to agree.
negotiation.driver_leave_button: 🚪 Stop waiting and look for other offers
negotiation.driver_left: 👌 You stopped waiting for this request. Other offers will reach you soon.
negotiation.driver_leave_active: ⚠️ Your offer is in front of the rider now, so there is no waiting to stop.
driver.offer_card_terms_open: 💰 No price set — agree with the requester in the chat
negotiation.driver_awaiting_selection: ⏳ Your offer is in front of the rider and they haven't chosen yet. The chat opens as soon as they choose you.
negotiation.rider_awaiting_selection: 👆 Choose the driver first from the card (“✅ Choose driver”) to open the chat, or move to the next driver.
driver.candidate_waiting: ⏳ Your acceptance was sent to the customer, who has {seconds} seconds to choose you. We will tell you the decision here.
driver.offer_held: The customer is reviewing another driver right now. Your offer stays open until it expires.
driver.candidate_accepted: ✅ The customer chose you for order {order}. Head to the pickup point now.
driver.candidate_declined: The customer did not choose you for order {order}; it went back to other drivers. Thanks for responding.
driver.candidate_expired: The customer's decision time for order {order} ran out; it went back to other drivers.
driver.candidate_cancelled: The customer cancelled order {order} before choosing. No need to head there.
chat.new_message_from_driver: 💬 You have a new message from the driver on order {order}. Open the order to read and reply.
chat.new_message_from_rider: 💬 You have a new message from the customer on order {order}. Open the trip to read and reply.
driver.location_reminder:
📍 We haven't received your location for {minutes} minutes while you're available.
To keep receiving offers, update it: open WASLA and allow location, or send your location here (📎 → Location).
Waslah can't read your location while it's closed. If you're no longer available, go unavailable.
driver.location_reminder_never:
📍 We haven't received any location from you while you're available.
To receive offers, update it: open WASLA and allow location, or send your location here (📎 → Location).
If you're not available, go unavailable.
driver.city_auto_changed:
📍 Based on your current location, your WASLA city is now {city}.
You'll receive {city} requests from now on. Your subscription hasn't changed.
driver.city_outside_coverage:
📍 Your current location is outside the cities where WASLA operates, so you won't receive requests until you're back in one.
If you're not working now, go unavailable.
tracking.rider_search_started: 🔎 It is time for your scheduled order {order} (pickup: {time}). We are searching for a driver now and will tell you as soon as one accepts.
tracking.rider_schedule_missed: ⚠️ Sorry: we could not start the driver search for your scheduled order {order} before its time ({time}) because of a temporary fault on our side, so the order was cancelled and no driver will be sent. You can create a new order now.
tracking.rider_search_expired: ⌛ The driver search for your order {order} has ended without any driver accepting it, so the order was closed and no driver will be sent. You can create a new order whenever you like.
driver.pickup_reminder: ⏰ Reminder: your pickup time for order {order} is {time}. Please head to the customer on time.
